endingScript.en: Our tiny pipe connects two friends.
endingScript.zh: 两个朋友，就用小管子传话。

endingScript.en: Videos, messages, even chats with AI—all use zeros and ones.
endingScript.zh: 视频、消息、AI聊天，全都用零和一。

en.spoken: Videos, messages, even chats with AI, all use zeros and ones.
en.instruction: Please speak warmly and clearly, with natural connected speech. Say AI smoothly as the familiar two-letter name, without a long gap. Keep the story light and curious.

zh.spoken: 视频、消息、人工智能聊天，全都用零和一。

endingScript.en: A funny story? A new game? What will you share today?
endingScript.zh: 一个好玩的故事？一个新游戏？今天你想分享什么？

en.instruction: Ask each question slowly, playfully, and clearly, like chatting with a child. Pause for half a second after story and after game. Keep the last question warm and inviting.

zh.instruction: 像和孩子聊天一样，轻快、俏皮地问这三个小问题。短句清楚亲切，问题之间自然稍停。
